'''Flatliner DarkSide LighSaber Combat''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Flatliner]]
* '''Published:''' 21 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 FirstMove Flatliner DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Im new to this game and this is my first darkside deck so please tell me ways to improve and any comments you have including what cards need taken out or replaced. the Destiny number will be show by each card by D and then the number following, is its destiny, important to have high destiny in this deck

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

I usualy always get a dark jedi into hand a place it on naboo from the start, then i pull the saber down and i pick up till i get another and occupy the 2 naboo sites, every turn i force drain like crazy on naboo wanting them to face me but they usualy dont so i go with my other characters to put beat downs on people while i drain like 7 force a turn from naboo what can not be canceled, any one they put on naboo what is not a jedi i can kill unless they have the shield what sucks in my opinion, i need help i need to improve this deck while keeping destiny hight and im relativly new to the game so do not confuse the hell out of me pls
